Yellow = open gap; Teal = shifting items; Green = sorted prefix.

text.tspan: Items shift right one position to make room for each new key.
O(n) best for nearly sorted data; O(n^2) worst; STABLE sort.

text.tspan: Left: shift cascade creating gap for key. Right: iterations growing the sorted prefix.
